summary: DC Vote says midterm results have created new momentum for statehood, while the organization documents ongoing attacks on DC's local authority and argues that the District's population already exceeds that of some states. The ACLU has raised concerns about the role of National Guard troops in D.C., and advocates are assessing where the statehood fight currently stands. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
